limitations: These are whole-plan geometry/HTTP checks against explicitly labelled original snapshots, not current live source reads.
Body bytes are actual uncompressed HTTP JSON response bodies; original cache-file bytes are a different metric.
Geometry reduction does not establish browser readiness, animation speed, source-network latency or a renderer winner.
Generalization parameters are not maximum deviation guarantees or survey accuracy. Boundaries remain display-only.
Five plans retain original coordinates because their coverage is unsafe to simplify. They are not counted as simplification successes.
Viewport subsets may contain fewer features; the full source inventory remains separate.
Unknown activity mappings, coverage gaps and official project acceptance remain unresolved. No licensing conclusion is derived.
Detailed measurements and source inputs remain private; no raw geodata is distributed in this artifact.
